# HCodeDiff

> Escaped unified and split diff views for application-supplied hunks.

[Start with the Hearth UI agent index](../../../llms.txt). This describes repository source for version 0.10.0. Match documentation to your installed source/release.

## Identity

- Vue export: `HCodeDiff` from `@hearth-ui/vue`.
- Custom element: `<hearth-code-diff>`.
- Constructor: `HearthCodeDiffElement` from `@hearth-ui/elements`.
- Category: Developer.
- [Implementation](https://github.com/samishal1998/hearth-ui/blob/main/src/components/HCodeDiff.vue).

## Choose and use it correctly

- Supply parsed diff hunks; this component renders changes and does not compute diffs. Unified/split modes use literal escaped text, line numbers and +/- cues. Consecutive removed/added lines pair in split view. Copy includes visible hunks only. maxLines defaults to 500 (maximum 5000); omitted lines are disclosed. Long code scrolls internally or wraps when requested.

## Public API

hunks: DiffHunk[] · label, maxHeight: string · view: unified | split · maxLines: number · wrap: boolean

A `?` marks optional source props. Props with defaults may be omitted. Internal `formDisabled` and `control-sync` plumbing is excluded below; do not use it in application code.

```ts
type Props = {
    hunks: DiffHunk[];
    label?: string;
    view?: "unified" | "split";
    maxLines?: number;
    maxHeight?: string;
    wrap?: boolean;
};
```

### Defaults

```ts
{
    hunks: () => [],
    label: "Code changes",
    view: "unified",
    maxLines: 500,
    maxHeight: "420px",
  }
```

### Events

update:view(unified | split), copied(), copy-error(string)

```ts
type Emits = {
    "update:view": [
        view: "unified" | "split"
    ];
    copied: [
    ];
    "copy-error": [
        message: string
    ];
};
```

Vue-emitted custom-element events expose argument arrays in `event.detail`. Listen on the element. Native events such as `click` retain their normal payloads. The elements package provides framework-independent DOM event types.

### Slots

None

Vue uses `<template #slotName>`; custom elements use `<div slot="slotName">`. Web components do not support Vue scoped slots.

### CSS parts

base, viewport

Use `hearth-code-diff::part(part-name)` for an exposed part or inherited `--h-*` tokens for shared styling. Native Vue components use the shared stylesheet and `h-*` classes.

## Supporting types

```ts
export interface DiffHunk {
    id: string;
    header?: string;
    lines: DiffLine[];
}

export interface DiffLine {
    kind: "context" | "added" | "removed";
    text: string;
    oldLine?: number;
    newLine?: number;
}
```

## Vue example

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { HCodeDiff } from '@hearth-ui/vue';
import '@hearth-ui/vue/styles.css';

</script>

<template>
  <HCodeDiff label="Configuration changes" :hunks="[{id:'h1',header:'@@ -1 +1 @@',lines:[{kind:'removed',oldLine:1,text:'retries: 2'},{kind:'added',newLine:1,text:'retries: 4'}]}]" />
</template>
```

## Web-component example

Provide a mount point. For field submission, use an owning native form; the auth page already contains its own form.

```html
<div id="example"></div>
```

This is bundler-based ESM. For raw HTML, load `dist/themes.css` with a link and import `registerElements` from `./dist/elements/index.js` instead. Initial array/object properties are assigned before connection to establish reset defaults.

```js
import { registerElements } from '@hearth-ui/elements';
import '@hearth-ui/elements/themes.css';
registerElements();

const mount = document.querySelector('#example');
const element = document.createElement('hearth-code-diff');
Object.assign(element, {
  "label": "Configuration changes",
  "hunks": [
    {
      "id": "h1",
      "header": "@@ -1 +1 @@",
      "lines": [
        {
          "kind": "removed",
          "oldLine": 1,
          "text": "retries: 2"
        },
        {
          "kind": "added",
          "newLine": 1,
          "text": "retries: 4"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
});

element.addEventListener('update:view', event => {
  const [value] = event.detail;
  // Update your application state using value.
});

mount.append(element);
```
